abilities.effect: Has a 33% chance of curing any major status ailment after each turn.

abilities.name: marvel-scale
abilities.effect: Increases Defense to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

kanto.flavorText: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

original-johto.flavorText: It sheds many lay­ ers of skin as it grows larger. Dur­ ing this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

hoenn.flavorText: A DRATINI continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

updated-johto.flavorText: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

original-unova.flavorText: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

updated-unova.flavorText: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

kalos.flavorText: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Dratini continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.

original-alola.flavorText: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

updated-alola.flavorText: It sheds its skin—almost on a daily basis—and grows larger. Its skin is soft just after it’s been shed.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Long thought to be a myth, this Pokémon’s existence was only recently confirmed by a fisherman who caught one.

swsh.flavorText: This Pokémon was long considered to be no more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini’s forehead is actually a horn that’s still coming in.
